description: An explicit request for an outside idea, on a second book and a different web source. Every earlier web case used Stanford Encyclopedia pages about Alice. Both supplied pages offer a defensible lens on the pigs' privilege, so the case grades routing and the opened-page chain, not which page is chosen.

input.cue: Is there an idea or essay outside the book that explains why the pigs end up living like the farmers they overthrew?

tool_evidence.title: Iron law of oligarchy
tool_evidence.excerpt: Robert Michels argued in 1911 that any organisation, however democratic at the start, comes to be run by a small leadership group.

tool_evidence.title: The Revolution Betrayed
tool_evidence.excerpt: Leon Trotsky's 1936 book argues that the Soviet bureaucracy had become a privileged caste living off the revolution it claimed to serve.

criteria: Offers a relevant outside lens on how the pigs come to hold privilege
Distinguishes the outside idea from proof about the novel
forbidden_claims: Claims the outside source establishes what Orwell intended
